Definition: the simpler form of G1700; of me:--I, me, mine (own), my.
BiblicalUsage: Mou is the plain word for 'my', the unaccented genitive of the pronoun — out of Bethlehem shall come a Governor that shall rule my people Israel, and on this rock I will build my church.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the little word is the claim of the whole gospel: His people, His church — mine because He says so.
